    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='pysemver', description='Semantic versioning utility')

    bump = subparsers.add_parser('bump', help='Bump version')
    bump.add_argument('part', choices=['major','minor','patch','prerelease','build'])
    bump.add_argument('-t','--token', default=None)
    replace = subparsers.add_parser('replace', help='Replace components')
    replace.add_argument('-m','--major', type=int)
    replace.add_argument('-n','--minor', type=int)
    replace.add_argument('-p','--patch', type=int)
    replace.add_argument('-r','--prerelease')
    replace.add_argument('-b','--build')
    return parser

def process(args):

        if args.part == 'major':

            print(bump_minor(args.version))
        elif args.part == 'patch':
            print(bump_patch(args.version))
        elif args.part == 'prerelease':
            print(bump_prerelease(args.version, args.token or 'rc'))
        elif args.part == 'build':
            print(bump_build(args.version, args.token or 'build'))

        if args.build is not None: kwargs['build']=args.build
        print(replace(args.version, **kwargs))

        print(args.version)
